title.zh: 特朗普再度寻求罢免美联储理事库克，白宫成立调查委员会
title.en: 特朗普再度寻求罢免美联储理事库克，白宫成立调查委员会

current_state.zh: The White House announced an investigative committee examining alleged false statements by Fed Governor Lisa Cook in mortgage documents, the latest move in Trump's campaign to reshape Fed leadership ahead of the next policy meeting.
